english: Th-this… is really Gamers, nyo!?
Ominous, nyu.
It was a normal store just hours ago.
A-awawa… it looks like a haunted house…
Rushing into action may have been for the best.\nGiven time, who knows how far\nthey'd have twisted this space into danger…
Welcome to my Gamers Castle, nyo.
It's you, nyo! How dare you turn Gamers\ninto something like the demon world, nyo!!
It happens all the time in games, nyo.\nWhat was once a beautiful royal castle\nbecomes an impregnable demon castle when the Demon Lord moves in, nyo!
A demon castle!?
I remodeled it after the final boss's castle\nfrom some famous blockbuster RPG, nyo.\nEnjoy it to the fullest — through your tears, nyo.
That's in terrible taste!
Nyoo!?\nAnything but that pain again, nyo!!
What is Dejiko-san afraid of?
Um, the final dungeon of some game\nwas super hard… and it\nreminded her of it… maybe?
If she thinks like I do,\nthere's no doubt the model is THAT, nyo!\nS-so scary, nyo… tremble tremble!
Come up to the top floor, and I'll fight you, nyo.\nI don't think you can, but good luck, nyo~.
Dejiko, if it's something you'd think up,\nyou can clear it, right?
Usada doesn't understand anything, nyo…\nThere's no way modern kids understand\nthe sheer evil of old RPG dungeons, nyo…!!
I don't really get it, but\nthis is no time to lose heart!\nWe're protecting Gamers, right!
The Polyal is only here,\nso we have to take it back, right?
First we just take out the small fry, right?
From here, we proceed carefully.\nNobody gets isolated. Watch out.\nMind the traps too.
Yes!
Bold yet careful — the careful part, desu~!\nCaution, caution, desu~!
O-hohohoho!\nI'm number one! I'll wipe you all out\nand hog all the glory!!
…You're on 1F because\nyou're the weakest, nyo.
Huh?
What RPG puts a strong character\nas the first boss, nyo?
Shut up!
No way…
1F cleared!
That went smoothly.\nWere we a little too cautious, I wonder?
That's just right.\nLulling you with an easy start to invite carelessness —\nthat's tactics 101.
Wah! Jeanne-san, you're so cool!
Even if she's the black one, being used as bait\nto invite carelessness — where do I direct this anger…
W-well… Usada-san's charm is\nmore cuteness than strength, after all.
Siesta-san is right.\nAs a girl, that's surely\nthe correct way to be?
Usada-san's best trait is\nhow she seems a little unlucky in life, desu~!\nThat's what's lovely about her, desu~!
Right, that's it!\nI'm a delicate maiden, in other words!
(She's so simple-minded, nyu)
Leave the blissed-out Usada alone —\nlet's head up, nyo!
1F was just the Usada zone after all, nyo.\nThe real deal starts here, nyo~!
What's 'just' supposed to mean!
It's a ploy to make you lose your cool.\nDon't play into their hands.
Yeah!\nGet right up in her face\nand complain directly!
You're going to die, nyu.
A tiny one's come out!
Better not let your guard down, nyu.
Don't be fooled by looks. Take her down for sure.
This is awkward…
That's part of the plan, nyo!
Pisses me off, nyu. I'll curse you, nyu.
Eh! A c-curse…!?
Just have Shirayuki exorcise it, nyu.
Puchiko-san is so calm.
She rivals Jeanne.
Where did Dejiko and Puchiko diverge?
What are you saying, nyo!\nI'm the better one, nyo!\nA little sister better than her big sister…
There are tons!
…You said it, nyo~.
Now, next is the 3rd floor.\nThere may be tricky mechanisms soon.
Any problems?\nSpeak up if anyone's tired.\nI won't push you too hard.
Still full of energy~!
I'm still fine too.
I'll rampage even more!
In terms of show excitement, we're still in the first half!\nIt gets interesting from here!
You finally made it to 3F, nyo.\nEverything so far\nwas basically a tutorial, nyo.
What's this 'choo' whatever!?
Um, it's a word you hear a lot in games…\nstep-by-step basics review…\nlike practice before the real thing, I think!
Then the real thing starts here.
We've prepared the full-fledged traps\nyou've all been waiting for, nyo.\nLike pitfalls that drop you to the floor below, nyo~!
The worst trap, nyo!\nEveryone, watch you don't fall, nyo!
Don't get distracted by battle\nand fall.
Look forward to the gatekeeper too, nyo.\nWell, do your best, nyo~.
The fighting itself is nothing!\nWatch the traps!
That's the way for this floor.\nBegin the operation!
That's… a black Jeanne-san!?
There's one of me too…
A Jeanne-san lookalike…!\nSh-she looks tough…
I'll turn you all into shaved ice… sweet, sweeet…
Don't use Orléans' silver ice for such foolishness.
She seems quite different from Jeanne-san?
If it's shaved ice, ditch that scary sword\nand bring a spoon!
Ding-ding-ding, nyo~.\nThat black one is a fake Dark Jeanne, nyo!
A fake!?
We were short on gatekeepers,\nso I rushed out a fake, nyo!\nBut she's twice as strong as the real thing, nyo!!
Twice as strong as Jeanne-san?
She seems strong in a different direction, though.
Twice-as-hard-to-melt shaved ice… twice the sweetness…
She doesn't seem to have much cooking sense.
She's saying pretty dark stuff, though.\nSounds like she wants to eat us…
Tasteless…\nCouldn't they have done something about her personality?
Jeanne, are you angry —\nafter telling everyone else to stay calm?
Unfortunately, yes… while staying perfectly calm.
Jeanne-san is good at disguises, after all.
I'll handle that one.
Looks like there's no part for us…
Sc-scattering…!
At least vanish beautifully…
Oh my, well done.
They must be out of ideas now!\nLet's head to 4F!
There might be someone even more intense on 4F?
I'm getting a little hopeful, nyu.
You made it to 4F, nyo.\nThe real tears start here, nyo~.
One question, nyo!\nIs there a trap that sends us back to 1F, nyo?
Tell me, nyo!!
Look forward to it, nyo!! Transmission over, nyo!
There IS one, nyo? There IS one, nyo!!\nHiding it means there is one, nyooo!!
Calm down, Dejiko.\nEven if someone falls into a trap,\nit doesn't mean everyone gets sent back to 1F…
Naive, nyo! If it's modeled on games,\nsending everyone back to the start\nis totally standard, nyo!!
I think there is.\nActually, Dejiko would totally do it.
Distance-wise,\nit's not that far, though.
The stairs are right there, after all.
That assumes the enemies stay wiped out\neven if we go back down, nyo. Unfortunately,\ngames don't work that way, nyo…
Oh, that's right!\nThere were times we had to redo it all…
Don't tell me we'll have to fight\nanother knockoff of me?
In a game, that's how it'd go, nyo.
…Alright, let's proceed with maximum caution.
Hogee~!
There it is, nyo!!
It looks like a black Tsubasa, but what the hell is that!?
Boee~!
Wah!\nWhat an energetic singing voice!
Tone-deaf, nyu.
Huh? What's wrong with it, desu~?\nShe's just singing normally, desu~???
(Oh right, [MERU]-san is tone-deaf…)
(The fact he doesn't blurt that out anymore\nmeans [CLAUDE] is growing too)
What a terrible song!!
Good thing Tsubasa isn't here…
If she were, it would have been\nunthinkable.
We'd best dispose of it quickly.
Bogeh~! Bogeh~!
Just shut up already!! Ugh, so irritating!!
Boee~! Boee~!
A Symphogear activating from THAT…\nwhat a bad joke…
It was probably just made to look the part;\nnot an actual Symphogear.
For a knockoff it performed well, but\nknowing the real Kazanari Tsubasa,\nall I can say is it left me wanting.
Honestly, an enraged Tsubasa seeing this\nwould be far scarier…
If Tsubasa had gone wild,\nthis place would be a crater by now, nyo…
A dangerous trap in a different sense, nyu.
The next floor is the last.\nStay sharp to the end\nand seize victory for sure.
Yes. Let's all make it through safely.
Well done surviving, elite warriors, nyo.\nI commend your fine efforts, nyo.
You didn't run away —\nI'll praise you for that, nyo~!
What boss would flee\nfrom the final dungeon, nyo?
More importantly, I have a proposal, nyo.
What is it, nyo?
Won't you join forces with me, nyo?\nRight now I'll even throw in half the world, nyo.
The classic line.
Um, I think saying 'yes'\nends badly…
Obviously a straight shot to the bad end, nyu.
The usual Dejiko might have been\ntempted by that offer, nyo.
But now I'll choose 'no' without hesitation, nyo!
Wah! Dejiko-senpai, you're so cool!
Before talking about the world,\nget out of Gamers, nyo!!
A squatting nuisance offering half the world —\nthat's beyond nonsensical, nyo!
An argument so sound there's no comeback…
Even an elementary schooler would get it, nyu.
Fine, nyo.\nThe refusal is part of the formula, nyo.
But here's the twist where evil wins, nyo!!\nThat's the script, nyo!!\nCome on out, nyooo!!
The ones we just beat are here too, nyo!!
I didn't have time,\nso they don't have speech functions, nyo.\nBut with numbers, they're still fighting strength, nyo.
Shouldn't you have given the Tsubasa knockoff\na singing function?
If they don't talk,\nthey're easier to fight even in our own forms.
Hero Dejiko, let's settle this, nyo!\nWhoever wins this battle rules the world, nyo!
It's pretty one-sided roleplay, but\nI'll play along, nyo!\nDeath to the Demon Lord, nyooo!!
To be driven this far, nyo…
Act cool all you want,\nbut you're just an otaku who drew weird doujinshi, nyu.
What do you even want, nyo?\nYou're probably just a small fry\nin the Dark Army, nyo?
…As long as it's fun, nyo.
Nyo?
I don't need sadness or suffering anymore, nyo.
What do you mean, hey!?
If you want to know, try defeating the Demon Lord, nyo.\nBut I won't go down easy, nyo!!
I-I lost, nyo.\nI knew it would end like this… nyo.
Tell me what your goal was, nyo.
It was short, but it was fun, nyo…\nLosing stings, but\nI don't feel bad, nyo…
What WAS your goal, nyo? Tell me, nyo!
Dejiko… really suits\nbeing happy, nyo…
Sadness, pain, despair —\nI hate them, nyo… Dejiko should\nAlways be smiling…
…She vanished, nyo.
She looked content at the end.
Feels like we beat someone\nwe shouldn't have… leaves a bad taste…
Still, they wished for battle.\nThen we could not avoid engaging.
What's so fun about playing\nDemon Lord's castle, nyo!
There are tons of more fun things, nyo!\nSo why, nyo…
──Hours later
Whew,\nlooks like cleanup will take a while again.
This is why I hate\nfighting at Gamers…
Speaking of which, where's Dejiko?\nI don't see her.
She's usually so eager to work at times like this.\nI wonder what's up?
Sorry to keep you waiting, nyo.
Wow! You're like a princess, desu~!!\nEven if it's not Rena-san,\nI want to take you home, desu~!!
What's with the outfit?
It's another of my outfits, nyo.\nDejiko protects Akihabara —\na symbol of that resolve, nyo!
Hmm, a pretty Dejiko.\nLike royalty from somewhere.
Akihabara is Dejiko's second home, nyo.\nProtecting it is\nlike my mission, nyo.
(Maybe the black Dejiko\nreally felt the same way, nyo…?\nMaybe something sad, something painful happened…)
Um, Dejiko-chan…?\nCould it be, really…
…Right now I'm just a humble\nGamers clerk, nyo.
Now then, back to cleaning, nyo~.
Sorry, but cleaning will have to wait.
Nyo? What do you mean, too bad, nyo?\nIs it break time, nyo?
No — it seems the enemy's main force has arrived.
The main force!? What do you mean!
The black Dejikos we just fought\nweren't the main force!?
That's right.
What do we do? Intercept them here?
No, we intercept outside.\nIf THAT arrives,\nwe'll be wiped out all at once inside a building like this.
That means…?
Yes… the black Louise.
//END
